# Asaṅga

*310 – 390 · Indian · [Yogācāra](../movements/yogacara.md)*

Indian monk, co-founder with his brother Vasubandhu of the [Yogācāra](../movements/yogacara.md) school, whose doctrine he set out in the Mahāyānasaṃgraha.
